data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that records the planned departure time specified by a rail journey plan.
data_properties.label: has planned departure time
data_properties.rationale: Required manifest literal on the plan ICE, using xsd:dateTime, so scheduled time is not asserted of the journey process or of a person.

data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that records the string service code associated with a passenger train.
data_properties.label: has train service code
data_properties.rationale: Required manifest literal on passenger train. It is not a substitute for has_tail_number, has_rail_service_code, or a train individual identifier.

design_warnings: Candidate TBox report only; these are not approved ontology assertions and no OWL axioms are emitted at this stage.
All eight target concepts lacked exact-name matches, so all eight are CREATE. Air analogues are comparisons only and are not owl:equivalentClass links.

Two loaded reservation classes are homonyms: local reservation is under material information bearer, while CCO reservation is an information content entity. Rail reservation information follows the CCO ICE parent required by contract.
Rail ticket follows loaded ticket as a material information bearer. Ticket information content is not modeled by this class.

Railway station under building may be too narrow for platforms, trackwork, and site; facility and location should be separated in a later review. Building is used only because the contract and source classes supply it.
Train under bare BFO object is intentionally coarse; no unsupplied vehicle or artifact parent was invented.
specifies_rail_journey relates an information content entity class to a process class. That can blur a plan, a process universal, and a particular occurrence if later used in ABox data.
occurs_aboard_train, departs_from_station, and arrives_at_station are convenience relations and do not replace BFO participation or occurrence-location axioms.
Loaded has_arrival_airport and has_departure_airport are datatype properties and must not be reused or collapsed into the new station object properties.

Rail passenger role is a BFO role, not a person, and is not a person-of-interest, social-media user, or threat class. No named individuals, trip records, or statements about specific persons are proposed.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and a railway station at which that journey arrives.
object_properties.label: arrives at station
object_properties.rationale: Required manifest relation from the journey process to its arrival station. It is not a reuse of has_arrival_airport, which is loaded as a datatype property and concerns airports.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and a railway station from which that journey departs.
object_properties.label: departs from station
object_properties.rationale: Required manifest relation from the journey process to its departure station. It is not a reuse of has_departure_airport and does not introduce a near-synonym property.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the train aboard which that journey occurs.
object_properties.label: occurs aboard train
object_properties.rationale: Required manifest relation linking the travel process to the conveying train object. It is a domain convenience relation, not a claim that BFO participation has been fully axiomatized.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey plan and the rail journey specified by that plan.
object_properties.label: specifies rail journey
object_properties.rationale: Required manifest relation from plan information to the rail journey class. Domain is the ICE and range is the process, preserving the plan versus occurrence distinction at the class level.

rail_classes.definition: A material object that is a rail vehicle, consisting of one or more connected rail cars, intended to travel on railway tracks.
rail_classes.label: train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract requires a new class under BFO object, parallel to Airplane as a material vehicle and not equivalent to it.
review_notes: Direct subclass of BFO object is coarse; a vehicle or artifact parent was not prescribed and must not be invented.
Comparison with Airplane is analogical only, not owl:equivalentClass.
Do not mint train individuals in this TBox stage.

rail_classes.definition: A train whose designed function includes carrying persons who bear a rail passenger role.
rail_classes.label: passenger train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract specializes the proposed train class, mirroring commercial airplane under airplane without equating them.
review_notes: Parent is the proposed train IRI, not BFO object and not person.
The loaded analogue IRI contains the source spelling Commcercial_airplane; use it only as a comparison.
Freight or mixed-use trains are not implied by this subclass.

rail_classes.definition: A building that is a facility at which a rail journey may depart or arrive and at which persons bearing a rail passenger role may board or alight.
rail_classes.label: railway station
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract follows the airport-under-building pattern and uses the loaded building class as direct parent.
review_notes: Building is present in source classes and required by contract, though it is absent from available_parent_classes.
A station may include platforms, tracks, and a site that are not one building; facility and spatial location may need later separation.
Not equivalent to airport, arrival airport, or departure airport.
No station individuals are proposed.

rail_classes.definition: A process in which a train travels along railway tracks from a departure railway station to an arrival railway station.
rail_classes.label: rail journey
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match or air-class analogue was supplied. The contract places the actual journey under BFO process so it stays distinct from plan and reservation information.
review_notes: This is an occurrent travel process, not a journey plan, reservation, ticket, or trip record.
Do not confuse it with Act of Flight Plan, which is a planning act rather than a flight occurrence.
No journey individuals or statements about particular travelers are proposed.

rail_classes.definition: An information content entity that specifies a planned rail journey, including planned endpoints and timing, and is not itself a rail journey process.
rail_classes.label: rail journey plan
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract parents the plan under information content entity, matching Flight plan as a comparison only.
review_notes: ICE, not a BFO process and not a material bearer.
A plan is about a specified journey; linking it directly to rail journey particulars can blur plan and occurrence.
Not owl:equivalentClass to Flight plan.

rail_classes.definition: A material information bearer that is a ticket and bears information authorizing travel associated with a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail ticket
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract models the ticket as a material bearer under the loaded ticket class, not as the information the ticket bears.
review_notes: Loaded ticket is under IAO material information bearer; this class follows that commitment.
Ticket information content, if needed later, must be a separate ICE and is not created here.
Boarding pass is a comparison only, not an equivalence.
No ticket individuals are proposed.

rail_classes.definition: An information content entity that is reservation information about a planned rail journey or related travel entitlement, distinct from any material booking artifact and from the rail journey process.
rail_classes.label: rail reservation information
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract parents this ICE under the loaded CCO reservation class, parallel to airline reservation information.
review_notes: Do not parent this under the local reservation class, which is asserted under material information bearer.
CCO reservation is an information content entity; the two reservation IRIs are homonyms and must stay distinct.
Analogues are comparisons only. No reservation individuals or person-specific booking statements are proposed.

rail_classes.definition: A role borne by a person in virtue of being carried, or authorized to be carried, on a passenger train during a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail passenger role
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was loaded. The contract places the class directly under BFO role so the passenger role is not a subtype of person.
review_notes: Role and person remain distinct; do not subclass person or create person individuals.
Loaded passenger is already a BFO role; this class is not parented under it because the contract prescribes BFO role.
Jetblue passenger is an analogue only and must not be reused or specialized as a named carrier role.
Do not connect this role to person-of-interest, social-media, or threat classifications.
